title: FRAs and interest-rate swaps as dated cash flows
objectives: Replicate advance-settled and end-settled FRAs with correct signs and dates
Derive par swap rates, off-market values, and discount-factor bootstraps
Value a floating bond between resets and reconcile swap bond/coupon-strip methods
Identify projection, discounting, overnight observation, and comparative-funding limitations
prerequisites: Discount factors, zero/forward rates, dated cash flows and present value; Chapter21 swap definitions and historical benchmark boundary.
source_scope: Full official English captions at positions55–57 read sequentially, all source examples independently recomputed. No comprehensive audiovisual audit. Forward-realization assumptions, FRA settlement timing, contractual reset rights, day counts, and single-curve shortcuts are explicitly qualified.
